source: Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Preah Vihear Province (មន្ទីរកសិកម្ម រុក្ខាប្រមាញ់ និងនេសាទ ខេត្តព្រះវិហារ), presentation "ដំណើរការផលិតកម្មគ្រាប់ពូជស្រូវសុទ្ធ" (Process of Pure Rice Seed Production), presented by Ms. Yem Sokey (យឹម សុគី), Deputy Head of the Office of Agricultural Techniques and Agricultural Productivity, dated 20 November 2017. Contact: ysophy168@gmail.com, 012 558 312.
text:
To prepare land for a rice seedling nursery bed used in pure seed production, first clean and soak the plot, then plow/harrow it 2-3 times so that the soil becomes level and has uniform physical characteristics. After initial preparation, wait 7-10 days to allow weed seeds and other volunteer plant material to germinate, then plow/harrow the soil again and level it a second time.

After final leveling, keep the bed appropriately moist, applying well-decomposed/rotted compost or manure evenly over the bed as base fertilization. Water the nursery bed as needed, but avoid letting water pool and stand at a depth that would submerge or drown the seed. If chemical fertilizer or other agrochemicals are applied to the nursery, they must be applied at the correct dose and farmers must follow label instructions carefully to avoid damaging the young seedlings.
